summary: Forestry Commission fire lookout in Aiken County, in use by 1936 and shown on a 1964 map; marked removed, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The lookout-history site marks the tower as removed.

events.note: Reported as also serving as a Red Cross first aid station, in a November 1936 Aiken Standard and Review item quoted on the lookout-history site
Shown as a lookout tower near Oakwood on a 1964 USGS topographic map published in 1965

evidence.supports: Tower in Aiken County, run by the South Carolina Forestry Commission
evidence.quote: South Carolina - Aiken County - South Carolina Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: Tower also served as a Red Cross first aid station
evidence.quote: the fire tower at Oakwood also serve as a Red Cross First Aid Station

evidence.supports: Fewer forest fires despite a severe drought
evidence.quote: in spite of the severe drought during the past year or so

evidence.supports: Speaker credited the extra fire towers and extra efforts
evidence.quote: This he attributes to the extra fire towers that have been built and the extra efforts that have been made.

evidence.supports: Oakwood listed under Aiken County and the Forestry Commission
evidence.quote: Aiken County - South Carolina Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: Tower system served the state since the 1930s
evidence.quote: The tower system had served the state since the 1930s.

evidence.supports: Commission closed the last forest fire lookout towers on October 1, 1993
evidence.quote: On October 1, the Forestry Commission closed the last of its forest fire lookout towers.

evidence.supports: Map shows a lookout tower near Oakwood beside the railroad
evidence.quote: passing through Oakwood near a Lookout Tower

evidence.supports: Community post calls it the Oakwood/Windsor Fire tower
evidence.quote: This is the Oakwood/Windsor Fire tower

notes_for_editor: The 1936 item is known only as quoted on the lookout-history site; the original Aiken Standard and Review was not read. The Facebook post was readable only by its title, so it is cited for the name alone. Consider adding Windsor to other_names after a second check. No build date, height, staffing or site description was found. The removal year is unknown, so no removed event is recorded.
